# Trackpad gestures (trackpad-gestures): spread two fingers over a pane of
# a split to zoom it, pinch to restore it; a swipe sideways (sidebar-swipe)
# either way shows or hides it.
action:new_split:right
wait:0.8
pinch:0.1
expect-zoomed:no
pinch:0.4
expect-zoomed:yes
pinch:-0.4
expect-zoomed:no
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
swipe:-150
expect-sidebar-shown:no
swipe:150
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
# Too short a swipe: nothing.
swipe:-40
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
# The same as the trackpad sends it: scroll events, began to ended, with
# Option held; either way toggles. Without Option it's a scroll.
trackpad-swipe:-200:option
expect-sidebar-shown:no
trackpad-swipe:-200:option
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
trackpad-swipe:200
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
